findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 披露多件 FERC 共站（co-location）程序將形塑 FERC/PJM 對共站負載的政策；Susquehanna ISA 修正案上訴已於 2026-01 自願撤回、該案結案。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: FERC Co-Location Proceedings. Several consolidation matters before the FERC are likely to shape FERC and PJM policy around co-located load.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：Cornerstone 收購交割條件為無禁止性法令；公司目前未知有反壟斷訴訟，但不保證；協議終止日 2027-01-15，反壟斷／監管未決時可自動延至 2027-07-15。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Although we are not currently aware of any, legal actions relating to the proposed Cornerstone Acquisition could be filed under antitrust, securities, or other laws.

findings.claim: Talen 宣布 Lawrenceburg、Waterford、Darby 收購取得其餘監管核准：印第安納州委員會 5/27、FERC 6/1。
PJM 市場監督人要求 FERC 駁回 Talen–Capital Power 電廠交易案，或附市場力承諾後重送。
